title: NeedKey
description: The key a placement need is ranked and carried under: adjacently tagged, `form` (kebab-case) beside `id`. `blob` is the legacy custody marker (`sha256-<hex>`) until the custody rows migrate, ranked over the marker's UTF-8 bytes so the XOR key is byte-identical to elohim-storage's reconcile/placement.rs hash_into_keyspace; `tree-view` is objects/tree-view's CID (R1: per tree root and view, never per blob); `task` is a TaskSpec's CID (§F); `session` a live session's CID. Every CID is a string in JSON (cid_serde's human-readable branch, G1). Lives in objects/ rather than inside intents/placement-need because two schemas carry it (the need and the explanation view) and the TypeScript codegen resolves cross-file references into objects/ but not into intents/ (scripts/codegen-ts.mjs loadRefMap). Wire shape: this schema is the source of record; placement_core::NeedKey (elohim/placement/core/src/need.rs) is its Rust mirror, not yet pinned to it by a test (follow-on: a placement-core schema_contract case that serializes each form and validates it here). Source of truth: the thing it keys, from which it is derived (Category C): a key, content-derived except the legacy blob marker.
